become-a-resident.earn: every place you turn out to belong to will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
become-a-resident.step.0.label: Register
become-a-resident.step.0.what: A new person creates an account on the platform.
become-a-resident.step.0.you: Fill in your name and email to create your account.
become-a-resident.step.1.label: Declare where you live
become-a-resident.step.1.what: You name the specific place where you live.
become-a-resident.step.1.you: Search for your home jurisdiction and select it.
become-a-resident.step.2.label: Presence confirms
become-a-resident.step.2.what: Your device sends a location ping to confirm you are physically present where you declared.
become-a-resident.step.2.you: Allow the app to read your location once.
become-a-resident.step.3.label: Residency confirmed
become-a-resident.step.3.what: A designated officer reviews your residency claim and confirms it.
become-a-resident.step.3.you: Watch your residency status change from pending to confirmed.
become-a-resident.step.4.label: You appear at every level
become-a-resident.step.4.what: The system links you to every tier of government above your declared place.
become-a-resident.step.4.you: Open your record to see all the chambers and governments you now belong to.
become-a-resident.step.5.label: Rights switch on
become-a-resident.step.5.what: Your right to vote and to stand for office activates in every jurisdiction you belong to.
become-a-resident.step.5.you: Open your record to see your active rights.
become-a-resident.title: Becoming a resident
become-a-resident.your_part: you do this one — register, declare where you live, and let your presence confirm it
bill.earn: the legislative session will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
bill.step.0.label: Introduced
bill.step.0.what: A chamber member drafts and submits a bill for the legislature to consider.
bill.step.0.you: Draft and submit your bill to start the legislative process.
bill.step.1.label: Committee
bill.step.1.what: The relevant committee studies the bill, hears testimony, and decides whether to send it to the floor.
bill.step.1.you: Follow the committee's work and file testimony if you want your position heard.
bill.step.2.label: Floor reading
bill.step.2.what: The bill's full text is read to all members before the vote.
bill.step.2.you: Review the bill text as it is presented to the chamber.
bill.step.3.label: Floor vote
bill.step.3.what: Every member of the chamber casts a vote on whether to pass the bill.
bill.step.3.you: Cast your vote on the bill.
bill.step.4.label: Enacted
bill.step.4.what: The bill reaches the required majority and is recorded as a new law.
bill.step.4.you: Review the enacted law as it appears in the chamber's record.
bill.step.5.label: Published
bill.step.5.what: The law is added to the public record and becomes visible to everyone.
bill.step.5.you: Read the law in the public records.
bill.title: A bill becomes law
board-meeting.earn: the board meeting will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
board-meeting.step.0.label: Convene
board-meeting.step.0.what: The board chair calls a meeting and notifies all board members.
board-meeting.step.0.you: Notify board members and set the meeting date from the organization's page.
board-meeting.step.1.label: Composition
board-meeting.step.1.what: The current board roster is confirmed before the meeting opens.
board-meeting.step.1.you: Verify the board member list on the organization's page.
board-meeting.step.2.label: Motions
board-meeting.step.2.what: Board members submit motions to add items to the meeting agenda.
board-meeting.step.2.you: Submit your motion from the organization's governance page.
board-meeting.step.3.label: Board vote
board-meeting.step.3.what: The board votes on each motion in turn until the agenda is complete.
board-meeting.step.3.you: Cast your vote on each open motion from the organization's page.
board-meeting.step.4.label: Minutes
board-meeting.step.4.what: The meeting minutes are published to the organization's record.
board-meeting.step.4.you: Read the published minutes on the organization's page.
board-meeting.title: Holding a board meeting
budget.earn: the legislative session will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
budget.step.0.label: Revenue
budget.step.0.what: The legislature reviews the jurisdiction's projected income for the period.
budget.step.0.you: Read the current treasury summary on the public finance page.
budget.step.1.label: Budget bill
budget.step.1.what: A member introduces a bill that proposes how to spend the available funds.
budget.step.1.you: Read the introduced budget bill on the bills page.
budget.step.2.label: Appropriations
budget.step.2.what: The chamber votes to approve specific spending amounts for each program.
budget.step.2.you: Watch the floor vote on the appropriations bill.
budget.step.3.label: Disbursement
budget.step.3.what: Approved funds transfer from the public treasury to authorized programs.
budget.step.3.you: Track outgoing disbursements on the public finance page.
budget.step.4.label: Ledger
budget.step.4.what: Every transaction is recorded on the public ledger and available for inspection.
budget.step.4.you: Read the audit record on the public records page.
budget.title: Enacting a budget
budget.your_part: you watch this one — the chamber writes it, and every disbursement lands on a ledger you can read
committee-session.earn: the committee hearing will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
committee-session.step.0.label: Convene
committee-session.step.0.what: The committee chair calls the meeting to order.
committee-session.step.0.you: Wait for the chair to open the meeting.
committee-session.step.1.label: Quorum
committee-session.step.1.what: Members register their attendance and the system checks that a working majority is present.
committee-session.step.1.you: Register your attendance so the quorum count includes you.
committee-session.step.2.label: Agenda
committee-session.step.2.what: The chair publishes the list of items the committee will address.
committee-session.step.2.you: Review the agenda to see what the committee will consider today.
committee-session.step.3.label: Testimony
committee-session.step.3.what: Residents and invited witnesses speak on the agenda items before the committee votes.
committee-session.step.3.you: File testimony if you want your position on the record.
committee-session.step.4.label: Motion
committee-session.step.4.what: A committee member formally proposes an action for the committee to vote on.
committee-session.step.4.you: Submit your motion if you have one to put before the committee.
committee-session.step.5.label: Committee vote
committee-session.step.5.what: Each committee member casts a vote on the motion before them.
committee-session.step.5.you: Cast your vote on the motion.
committee-session.step.6.label: Report
committee-session.step.6.what: The chair files a formal report recording the committee's decisions and recommendations.
committee-session.step.6.you: Read the committee report once the chair files it.
committee-session.title: A committee session, live
court-case.earn: the court hearing will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
court-case.step.0.label: Filed
court-case.step.0.what: A resident or advocate submits a civil or criminal case to the court.
court-case.step.0.you: File your case from the public docket page.
court-case.step.1.label: Panel
court-case.step.1.what: The court accepts the case and assigns a panel of judges to hear it.
court-case.step.1.you: Watch the court record the panel assignment on the judiciary page.
court-case.step.2.label: Hearings
court-case.step.2.what: The panel holds scheduled hearings where the parties and witnesses appear.
court-case.step.2.you: Follow the case on the public docket as each hearing is recorded.
court-case.step.3.label: Evidence
court-case.step.3.what: Advocates submit documentary and testimonial evidence to the panel.
court-case.step.3.you: Submit your evidence through the advocate console.
court-case.step.4.label: Jury
court-case.step.4.what: The panel issues a jury selection order and citizens are empanelled.
court-case.step.4.you: Watch the panel post the jury selection order on the judiciary page.
court-case.step.5.label: Arguments
court-case.step.5.what: Advocates file closing briefs and present final arguments before the panel.
court-case.step.5.you: File your closing brief through the advocate console.
court-case.step.6.label: Deliberation
court-case.step.6.what: The panel and jury deliberate in private to reach a verdict.
court-case.step.6.you: Wait for the deliberation to conclude before checking the docket.
court-case.step.7.label: Judgment
court-case.step.7.what: The panel announces its verdict and, where applicable, issues a sentencing order.
court-case.step.7.you: Read the judgment on the public case docket.
court-case.step.8.label: Opinion
court-case.step.8.what: The panel files a written opinion explaining the legal reasoning behind its ruling.
court-case.step.8.you: Read the published opinion on the public case docket.
court-case.title: A court case, end to end
election.earn: the candidate forum will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
election.step.0.label: Approval
election.step.0.what: Residents see the full candidate list and mark the ones they approve of.
election.step.0.you: Open the ballot and mark every candidate you approve of.
election.step.1.label: Candidate forum
election.step.1.what: Candidates present their platforms so residents can learn about them before the ranked vote.
election.step.1.you: Read candidate profiles and public statements before deciding your ranking.
election.step.2.label: Finalist cutoff
election.step.2.what: The election board closes the approval window and confirms which candidates advance.
election.step.2.you: Watch the finalist list appear on the election page.
election.step.3.label: Ranked vote
election.step.3.what: Residents rank the finalists from most to least preferred.
election.step.3.you: Open the ranked ballot and order the candidates as you prefer them.
election.step.4.label: Count
election.step.4.what: The system counts all ballots using the single transferable vote method.
election.step.4.you: Watch the round-by-round count on the results page.
election.step.5.label: Seated
election.step.5.what: The election board certifies the count and the winners are formally seated.
election.step.5.you: Watch the results page confirm the certified winners.
election.step.6.label: First session
election.step.6.what: The new chamber meets for the first time and each member takes the oath of office.
election.step.6.you: Watch each member accept their seat and take the oath.
election.title: An election, end to end
election.your_part: you vote this one — approve the candidates you trust, then rank them when the window opens
form-a-group.earn: the group meeting will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
form-a-group.step.0.label: Create
form-a-group.step.0.what: A person registers an informal group in the organization registry.
form-a-group.step.0.you: Open the organizations page and register the group.
form-a-group.step.1.label: Discuss
form-a-group.step.1.what: Group members post messages on the public square.
form-a-group.step.1.you: Post your thoughts and read what the others wrote.
form-a-group.step.2.label: Call a meeting
form-a-group.step.2.what: A member sets a time and invites the rest of the group to meet.
form-a-group.step.2.you: Send the invitation in the group's private room.
form-a-group.step.3.label: Decide
form-a-group.step.3.what: The group reaches an agreement and someone records it.
form-a-group.step.3.you: Post the decision so every member can see it.
form-a-group.step.4.label: Next steps (opt.)
form-a-group.step.4.what: The group may convert to a formal organization or start a petition.
form-a-group.step.4.you: Choose the next action in the organization registry or on the petitions page.
form-a-group.title: An informal group forms and meets
form-a-group.your_part: you do this one — start the group, invite your neighbours, and call the first meeting
generic.arc_rooms: follow the arc below — watch from the gallery, or take the floor where you’re a resident
mutual-aid.earn: the group meeting will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
mutual-aid.step.0.label: Post request
mutual-aid.step.0.what: A person lists a need for help on the open market.
mutual-aid.step.0.you: Open the open market and post a listing for what you need.
mutual-aid.step.1.label: A neighbor responds
mutual-aid.step.1.what: Another resident sees the request and offers help.
mutual-aid.step.1.you: Find the listing and submit an offer.
mutual-aid.step.2.label: Coordinate
mutual-aid.step.2.what: The two people agree on how the help will be provided.
mutual-aid.step.2.you: Exchange messages in a private room to arrange the details.
mutual-aid.step.3.label: Resolved
mutual-aid.step.3.what: The request is settled and the listing is closed.
mutual-aid.step.3.you: Open the listing and mark the request as complete.
mutual-aid.title: Asking for and giving help
mutual-aid.your_part: you do this one — post a request for help, or answer a neighbour’s
petition-to-referendum.earn: the referendum town hall will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
petition-to-referendum.step.0.label: Petition
petition-to-referendum.step.0.what: A resident files a petition to place a question before the legislature.
petition-to-referendum.step.0.you: Open the petitions page and submit the petition text.
petition-to-referendum.step.1.label: Signatures
petition-to-referendum.step.1.what: Residents sign the petition until it reaches the required threshold.
petition-to-referendum.step.1.you: Find the petition and add your signature.
petition-to-referendum.step.2.label: Reaches legislature
petition-to-referendum.step.2.what: The election board certifies the signature count and sends the petition to the legislature.
petition-to-referendum.step.2.you: Watch the petition status on the petitions page for the certified notice.
petition-to-referendum.step.3.label: Referendum
petition-to-referendum.step.3.what: The legislature votes to send the question directly to residents for a decision.
petition-to-referendum.step.3.you: Watch the legislature cast its delegation vote on the referendums page.
petition-to-referendum.step.4.label: Town hall
petition-to-referendum.step.4.what: Residents hold a public discussion about the question before voting.
petition-to-referendum.step.4.you: Post testimony or read what others have said on the public square.
petition-to-referendum.step.5.label: Vote
petition-to-referendum.step.5.what: Eligible residents cast a yes or no vote on the referendum question.
petition-to-referendum.step.5.you: Open the referendum on the referendums page and cast your vote.
petition-to-referendum.step.6.label: Result
petition-to-referendum.step.6.what: The count closes and the outcome is published.
petition-to-referendum.step.6.you: Check the result on the referendums page.
petition-to-referendum.title: From a petition to a referendum
petition-to-referendum.your_part: you do this one — sign (or start) the petition, then vote when the referendum opens
public-service.earn: the legislative session will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
public-service.step.0.label: Charter CGC
public-service.step.0.what: The legislature passes an act to create a Common Good Corporation to deliver a service to everyone in the jurisdiction.
public-service.step.0.you: Watch the bill move through chamber readings and become the corporation's founding act.
public-service.step.1.label: Board of Governors
public-service.step.1.what: The executive nominates governors for the corporation and the legislature votes to confirm them.
public-service.step.1.you: Watch the nomination arrive at the executive and the consent vote seat the board.
public-service.step.2.label: Serves the public
public-service.step.2.what: The corporation begins operating and its service is open to every resident in the jurisdiction.
public-service.step.2.you: Find the organization in the registry to read its public record and see its active status.
public-service.step.3.label: Monopoly path (opt.)
public-service.step.3.what: The legislature votes to grant the corporation sole rights in its service area.
public-service.step.3.you: Watch the monopoly acquisition vote and see the corporation's registry record update.
public-service.title: A government creates a public service
start-org.earn: the board meeting will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
start-org.step.0.label: Register
start-org.step.0.what: A resident registers a new organization with the government.
start-org.step.0.you: Register your organization from the organizations registry.
start-org.step.1.label: Charter
start-org.step.1.what: The founding members set the organization's name, purpose, and governance rules.
start-org.step.1.you: Complete the charter details on the organization's profile page.
start-org.step.2.label: First board
start-org.step.2.what: The founding members elect the first board of directors.
start-org.step.2.you: Administer the first board election from the organization's page.
start-org.step.3.label: Onboard
start-org.step.3.what: The first members apply to join the newly formed organization.
start-org.step.3.you: Apply for membership from the organization's listing page.
start-org.step.4.label: Market (opt.)
start-org.step.4.what: The organization optionally registers to buy and sell on the open market.
start-org.step.4.you: File the market participation form from the organizations page.
start-org.title: Starting an organization
start-org.your_part: you do this one — register the organization, write the charter, and seat the first board
stipend-and-tax.earn: the places this journey touches will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
stipend-and-tax.step.0.label: Stipend run
stipend-and-tax.step.0.what: The government clock triggers a payment of civic stipends to every eligible resident.
stipend-and-tax.step.0.you: Open the stipend page to see the current run, its schedule, and the amount paid per resident.
stipend-and-tax.step.1.label: Your receipt
stipend-and-tax.step.1.what: The stipend amount posts as a credit in your wallet immediately after the run completes.
stipend-and-tax.step.1.you: Open your wallet to confirm the deposit and trace it back to the public stipend run.
stipend-and-tax.step.2.label: Tax filing
stipend-and-tax.step.2.what: You send a portion of your income to the public treasury as a tax payment.
stipend-and-tax.step.2.you: Use the funds transfer form to send the payment to the government account.
stipend-and-tax.step.3.label: Public ledger
stipend-and-tax.step.3.what: Every government receipt and disbursement is recorded and open for any resident to read.
stipend-and-tax.step.3.you: Read the treasury page to see the jurisdiction's full public financial record.
stipend-and-tax.title: The money between a person and their government
stipend-and-tax.your_part: this one comes to you — the stipend lands in your wallet, and you file the tax side yourself
two-governments.earn: the referendum town hall will greet you as someone who knows the ropes
two-governments.step.0.label: Discover a peer
two-governments.step.0.what: A jurisdiction finds another government on the federation mesh and reads its public descriptor.
two-governments.step.0.you: Open the federation page to see known peer jurisdictions and their connection status.
two-governments.step.1.label: Trust each other’s records
two-governments.step.1.what: Both governments verify and accept each other's cryptographic records as authoritative.
two-governments.step.1.you: Watch the federation status page as the peer link becomes confirmed on both sides.
two-governments.step.2.label: Trade talks
two-governments.step.2.what: Representatives from both jurisdictions negotiate and sign a formal cross-border agreement.
two-governments.step.2.you: Review the draft agreement on the agreements page and countersign when the terms are settled.
two-governments.step.3.label: Union or border
two-governments.step.3.what: The legislature votes to form a union with the peer jurisdiction or to settle their shared boundary.
two-governments.step.3.you: Watch the union formation vote in your chamber or read the boundary outcome in the jurisdiction record.
two-governments.title: Two governments meet, trade, and merge
